answer: Continuous physical-presence attestation.** Each identity must periodically solve a challenge that requires holding a unique, factory-serialized hardware element and reporting its live sensor readings, so every registration maps to one physical device. An operator can only fake presence by buying another device per identity. The network timestamps each echo from that device against local conditions—a gale warning, ambient nectar-level sensor drift—so replaying another unit's data fails. Spoofing costs the full hardware price plus replacement per Sybil, making mass fakery economically unviable.
